value.title: spawn-reports-bind
value.summary: pij-rs spawn distinguishes dispatched from bound and surfaces a named failure with the child's last log lines when the pane dies before the seat binds.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: req-0035 (meadowlark 2026-09-02): pij-rs spawn --harness pi --bin omp returned ok:true; seat pij-cheerful-orlandine stayed idle/proc null and the pane was gone within ~2 min; nothing readable said why (no per-seat spawn log). Dispatch is not delivery. Also known: pij fires false terminal-absence notices on many omp spawns, and omp silently falls back to Opus 5 when its model call fails.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 spawn returns {dispatched:true, bound:false|true, pane, pid} and, unless --no-wait, waits up to N seconds for the seat to register (extension boot ping / /v1/register from that pane) and reports bound or a named failure.

G2 On a pane that exits before bind: capture the child exit code and the last 20 lines of its output (tmux capture-pane before the window is gone, or a pipe-pane log under ~/.pij-rs/spawn/<spawn_id>.log) and return them in the failure.
G3 A spine event spawn.bound / spawn.failed with the evidence so it is locatable by seat/spawn id later.
G4 Fix the false terminal-absence notice if it is the same code path; otherwise record it as a separate finding with file:line.

value.text: LIVE: pij-rs spawn of an omp with a deliberately bad --model → returns spawn.failed naming the exit code and the omp log line that refused; pane transcript pasted.
value.claim: a dead-before-bind spawn is reported, not ok:true

value.text: LIVE: a normal omp spawn returns bound:true with the seat id within the wait window.
Unit RED-first: child exits 1 immediately → caller sees exit + log path, never ok:true.
